title: Freeze a reproducible dataset release
description: Resolve each mutable dependency and watch the candidate change from a convenient path into replayable evidence.

dimensions.label: Source snapshot
dimensions.question: Which source state?
dimensions.risk: A query against latest partitions can return different rows after late arrivals, corrections, or retention changes.

options.label: Latest warehouse partitions
options.detail: The same query is rerun against whatever exists now.

options.label: Pinned object snapshots
options.detail: Exact partition versions and content digests are recorded.

dimensions.label: Transformation
dimensions.question: Which feature logic?
dimensions.risk: Current code can change joins, defaults, filtering, or feature windows without changing the dataset path.

options.label: Current workspace code
options.detail: Execution uses whichever files and dependencies are installed.

options.label: Commit and image digest
options.detail: Source revision, entry point, configuration, and runtime are pinned.

dimensions.label: Label evidence
dimensions.question: Which labels?
dimensions.risk: A mutable label column can absorb corrections or rubric changes, altering targets without an explicit release.

options.label: Current label column
options.detail: Corrections and adjudications overwrite the values used before.

options.label: Label batch and rubric
options.detail: Targets resolve to a reviewed batch, rubric, and adjudication policy.

dimensions.label: Split assignment
dimensions.question: Which train/eval split?
dimensions.risk: Unseeded row-level randomization moves examples between train and evaluation sets and may separate records from the same entity.

options.label: Random on every run
options.detail: Rows are shuffled without a recorded seed or grouping key.

options.label: Stable entity hash
options.detail: Entity key, hash function, proportions, and seed are recorded.
